description: Fix a List.Sort-based priority queue that re-sorts by priority alone on every push (losing FIFO order across interleaved pops) into a genuinely stable one
prompts: StablePriorityQueue.cs keeps a List and re-sorts it by priority alone on every Push using List<T>.Sort, which is an UNSTABLE sort in .NET (it does not preserve the relative order of equal elements) - ties between equal-priority items can come out in any order. Fix Push/Pop so that: (1) items with a lower priority number come out first, and (2) items with EQUAL priority always come out in the order they were originally pushed (FIFO) - add an explicit monotonically increasing insertion-order field and use it as the sort key's tiebreaker, or use a stable sort (OrderBy, which IS stable in LINQ) instead of List<T>.Sort.
name: add_csharp_stable_priority_queue
